claims.sentence: However, there are still a significant number of patients who have poor response to the first generation of TKI drugs, imatinib, most of them have early molecular response failures (BCR-ABL（IS）\>10% at 3 or 6 months) ，which means lower rates of molecular response, increased risk of progression, and higher overall survival.
